wc:minerva-month-calendar.summary: Month grid with per-day event counts and keyboard navigation.
wc:minerva-month-calendar.description: A Monday-first, six-week month grid (`<MonthCalendar>` of React). Each day shows its number of events; selecting a day lists its events below the grid. Fully keyboard operable as an APG date grid: one tab stop (roving `tabindex` on the `gridcell`s themselves, `aria-selected`, no inner buttons), arrows, Home / End (week start / end), PageUp / PageDown (month), Shift+PageUp / PageDown (year), Enter / Space to select. The arrows follow the reading direction (RTL swaps left / right). Events are given through the `events` property. User navigation updates `month` / `value` and fires `minerva-month-change` / `minerva-change`.

properties.name: month
properties.description: Displayed month (any day of it; attribute "YYYY-MM"); defaults to the current month

properties.name: clickableEvents
properties.description: Renders the selected day's events as buttons firing `minerva-event-click`

properties.name: rangeStart
properties.description: First day of a highlighted range, "YYYY-MM-DD" (display only; pair with `range-end`)

properties.name: rangeEnd
properties.description: Last day of a highlighted range, "YYYY-MM-DD" (display only; pair with `range-start`)

properties.name: size
properties.description: Cell density: compact ("small"), default ("medium") or comfortable ("large")

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Blocks navigation, selection and event clicks

properties.name: hideEvents
properties.description: Hides the list of the selected day's events (the React library's `showSelectedDayEvents={false}`)

properties.name: previousMonthLabel
properties.description: Label of the previous-month button (default: localized)

properties.name: nextMonthLabel
properties.description: Label of the next-month button (default: localized)

properties.name: todayLabel
properties.description: Label of the button returning to the current month (default: localized "Today")

properties.name: emptyEventsText
properties.description: Text shown when the selected day has no events (default: localized)

properties.name: locale
properties.description: Locale of the month heading (Intl.DateTimeFormat); default: the library language

properties.name: events
properties.description: Events; each day shows how many it has

properties.name: getDayLabel
properties.description: Accessible label of a day cell, from the day ("YYYY-MM-DD") and its event count

properties.name: getEventsLabel
properties.description: Accessible label of the selected day's event list

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Select a day to list its events; arrows, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown (with Shift: a year) move the focus. Each day is a focusable grid cell marked aria-selected, so the selection is announced once.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: size="small" is a compact grid where events show as dots; size="large" is comfortable, with the day number at the top and the event badge at the bottom of a taller cell.

range.title: Highlighted range
range.description: rangeStart / rangeEnd tint the days in between and fill both ends (display only, in either order). Here a first click starts a new range and a second one closes it.
